summary: Apply FIDIC contract terms to project records, notices and claims. Explore the five-day construction contract law course and review the outline.
lede: Construction contract law training helps contract administrators, engineers and commercial specialists apply FIDIC procedures to project decisions and records. Participants compare the Red, Yellow and Silver Books, interpret contract documents and assess how responsibilities and risks are allocated. Practical exercises build skills in preparing notice and claim records, documenting Engineer decisions and organizing evidence for dispute pathways.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who work with construction contract terms, project decisions and supporting records, and need to apply FIDIC procedures in live delivery settings.
modules: FIDIC Contract Architecture and Legal Context
FIDIC Red, Yellow and Silver Books
FIDIC Risk Allocation and Project Scope
prerequisites: Working knowledge of construction project delivery and contract documents is expected. No coding or programming is required.
